$comment: Golden vectors for the derive seam (per-flow suites per system-design 3.1). Each vector carries an optional 'flow' field: "full" (default — absent means full) | "direct" | "solo". Flow selects the transition table (system-design 3.1 three-table definition): full = create→designing, design designing→implementing, code_changes implementing→reviewing, review pass/fail_code/fail_design → pending_approval/revising/designing, revision revising→reviewing, reject pending_approval→revising; direct = create→implementing, design in implementing is a REFERENCE record (no transition, no warning) and out-of-table in every other state, review fail_design is OUT_OF_TABLE (no designing to return to), everything else as full; solo = create→designing, design designing→implementing, code_changes implementing→pending_approval (review phase skipped), review and revision records are OUT_OF_TABLE in ANY state (with OUT_OF_TABLE taking precedence over INVALID_VERDICT), reject pending_approval→implementing (rework). Warning code vocabulary (mirrors WarningCode in src/types.ts): OUT_OF_TABLE = record does not fit current state, no fold + needs_attention; CLOSED_ABSORB = non-note/non-close record after closed, stays closed + needs_attention; INVALID_VERDICT = review with missing/invalid verdict, no transition + needs_attention (full/direct only — in solo every review is out-of-table before the verdict is evaluated); VERSION_GAP = version skips a number, fold by version order anyway (warning attached to the record after the gap); VERSION_DUPLICATE = repeated version, fold by version order anyway (warning attached to the duplicated version). Structural warnings are flow-independent. Rules: create produces no record so derive([]) is the flow's initial state (designing for full/solo, implementing for direct); note never changes status and never warns; decision(close) is valid in any state, idempotent in closed; needs_attention overrides waiting_for to human in any status including closed; note with payload.ack === true clears all warnings accumulated so far (no-op when clean); warnings are asserted as {version, code} only, never as text; project scope (task_id 'project') derives to null.
